bundle.shortDescription: Chena-Shell / Chena-Sftp — AI-friendly SSH terminal and file transfer
bundle.longDescription: Chena-Shell: a local SSH terminal by Chena with Material 3 UI, real-time host monitoring, built-in Chena-Sftp file transfer, and an embedded MCP server that lets AI agents attach to your sessions as a guest, run commands visibly, and detach when done.
